The flame is bright and prominent against a dark background, illuminating the thumb and fingers gripping the plastic body of the lighter. The lighter appears to be a standard cylindrical or rectangular disposable type with a metal wind guard.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The flame exhibits slight 'smearing' or softness at the edges where it meets the dark background, characteristic of AI-generated glow effects rather than optical bokeh. There is minor color bleeding (orange halo) into the dark background.

artifact_observations.location: Thumb contact point on lighter body
artifact_observations.reasoning: The boundary between the thumb and the lighter body is slightly indistinct. The plastic texture of the lighter seems to 'melt' slightly into the skin tone at the contact edge, lacking a sharp occlusion boundary.
